svg.text: Where the shipped chain stands and what is wrong (held-out test files of jobs 0-199, CC1p0pi selection, 2026-11-10)

Row 1: each block of the chain, what closes against Pandora and what is open. Row 2: the selection stage by stage. Row 3: the two open items traced to their cause. Green = closed or fixed, red = open.

The selection stage by stage, shipped chain against Pandora on the same 180,000 held-out neutrinos (7,659 primary signal)
signal / background: XSuM minus Pandora in selected events, primary signal definition. overlap: fraction of the Pandora-selected neutrinos that XSuM also selects
(per-event agreement). Statistical precision of the purity at 2prong-contained: 0.008. Pre-2prong background excess: +150 against +423 for the previous chain (vertex residual).
A. Background excess at containment (+135): the slice generator
Where: CC Npi and NC 2prong slices
CC Npi contained fraction of its 2prong slices 0.335 vs 0.290 (256 vs 222 events); NC 2prong +45
events (1,392 vs 1,347) with the containment rate right. Other 0pi and nue: within statistics. The
pre-2prong background excess fell from +423 to +150 with the vertex residual.
Cause: the exit <-> multiplicity link of CC + pion slices
In Pandora an exiting muon leaves fewer PFPs: n_pfp = 3 slices have the longest end in the FV 0.418
(0.56 at n_pfp >= 5); generated 0.498 at n_pfp = 3, flat in n_pfp. 2prong is 94% of n_pfp = 3, so
the extra contained CC Npi passes the cut. At the slice level (vertex in FV, nu_score > 0.45):
P(n_pfp = 3 | exit) - P(n_pfp = 3 | contained) = +0.025 Pandora, +0.011 generated.
Zone 1: true vertex in the FV (30%)
The link runs through the reco-vertex FV cut.
Was: a 4-6 cm vertex core (Pandora 0.5 cm)
pushed exiting-muon events out of the FV (pass
0.932). Fixed: vertex as the residual to the
true vertex, median 0.4 cm; FV pass by exit /

0.47. The vertex is right; the track given the
Tried and ruled out (same test sample; slice-generator figure, rows 2-4)
Two-stage flow with the counts as numbers (M2s: link closes, count lattice broken, efficiency
0.165); counts as a one-hot class (M2o: counts right, link lost); class from a classifier on the
generated stage 1 (M2c: = shipped, link lost); topology sampled after the flow (M2t); 4x topology
head; muon-hadron angles as inputs. None reproduces the link at the slice level (0.48-0.52 vs 0.45).
Next lever: generate the longest track jointly with the vertex for dirt neutrinos (an exit predictor
from the true muon line and the entry wall).
B. Signal mis-assigned at containment: the PFP generator
Truth-contained signal at 2prong in both chains: contained 0.866 vs 0.984 (-128 of 1,039). Primary
signal whose true muon or proton leaves the FV: reconstructed as contained 293 vs 103. Net primary
signal -36; truth-contained (notebook) signal -203, notebook purity 0.351 vs 0.418.
Cause: each containment condition is right, their joint is not
Exiting-muon 1p0pi, 2prong in both chains: longest end in FV 0.236 vs 0.224, second end 0.889 vs
0.888, one cathode side 0.674 vs 0.665; but given both ends in the FV, P(vertex and ends on one
cathode side) = 0.220 generated vs 0.064 Pandora. A Pandora muon that stops inside the FV after a
long path has crossed the cathode; the generated end keeps the vertex side. Contained signal fails
What the end point can and cannot be
From generator truth alone the muon end is
two draws of a perfect surrogate differ by 14.5
cm. Shipped: 11.6 cm per event, lateral scatter
The resolution is at the floor; closed.
What is missing: a correlation, not resolution
Which side of the cathode the end lies on is set
by the vertex x, the direction and the length;
the set flow smears it. Ruled out: end-point
bend fix (M3b), end as a direct target +
(no change in the FV / wall rates). Geant4 end-
point inputs (M3g, M3w) help but are not
Generate the track end relative to the cathode: a per-track flag 'end on the other side of the
cathode' (and the crossing point) as a target of the set flow, like the wall flags; or the end x as
the signed distance to the cathode. The hybrid (Pandora slices + generated PFPs) shows the same
joint loss (P(side | both ends) 0.205 vs 0.086), so the fix is in the PFP generator, not upstream.
Expected gain: the notebook purity (0.351 -> 0.418) and the -36 primary signal at containment.

Splits: the file assignment is a seeded shuffle of the file list; the datasets' test files were re-derived from the generators' training table on 2026-11-09 (before, 71% of them were training files; the
closure moved by 0.01). The cardinality head (matched slices per neutrino) is split on the card table and saw 90% of the held-out files; next training round: split by a hash of the file id.

Range momenta are generated as independent numbers (the range peak of stopping pions is smeared, 0.17 vs 0.22); the induction-plane chi2, unfitted PFPs, truth-match columns and cosmic-only slices are not
Per-column W1 of the slice block: median 0.016 of the transformed range; the largest values are the cohpi end points of the two-track block (5% of slices), measured before the end-point clip (in the
dataset: on the wall 0.433 vs 0.429, outside the TPC 0.000 vs 0.001).
